The Router's observation of 'blunt/fused claws' and 'ambiguous joint definition' is the most critical finding here. The severity of 2.0 is appropriate—it's noticeable but doesn't destroy the overall form. I would add that the background texture uniformity noted by the Router (severity 1.0) is a common AI artifact (repetitive noise pattern) but minor.

The image successfully conveys the essential characteristics of the target class.
